articles.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
articles.snippet: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Lighter recovers $5M after $10M exploit linked to compromised API keys
articles.snippet: Lighter restored withdrawals after recovering approximately $5 million in USDC, while blockchain analysts traced $10.4 million in funds moved during the exploit.

articles.title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
articles.snippet: Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.

articles.title: Enterprise blockchain is going to come back from the dead
articles.snippet: With scalability, privacy tools and onchain liquidity improving, businesses may finally have the infrastructure to make enterprise blockchain work.

articles.title: Saylor’s Strategy Keeps Buying Bitcoin, Adding 'A Little Orange' Through the Dip
articles.snippet: The modest purchase lifted Strategy’s stash to 850,849 BTC as chairman Michael Saylor shrugged off a sharp downturn, posting that “this dip could use a little orange.”
